title: Smoky Kenyan Lamb Kebabs with Crispy Thai Sauce
description: A fusion of Kenyan and Thai flavors in this smoky lamb kebab dish, served with a crispy sauce.
instructions: 2. In a bowl, mix together Kenyan spices, lamb cubes, and a pinch of salt. Let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
3. Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
4. Brush coconut oil onto the grill grates.
5. Grill lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
6. In a blender or food processor, combine Thai red curry paste, crushed peanuts, fish sauce, and honey. Blend until smooth.
7. Grill the sauce mixture for 2-3 minutes, or until fragrant and slightly charred.
8. Serve lamb kebabs with crispy Thai sauce and garnish with chopped cilantro.
